title: Interdependence
definition: Interdependence in ecology refers to the complex web of reciprocal relationships where organisms, populations, and abiotic factors rely on each other for survival, energy flow, and nutrient cycling within an ecosystem.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding 'Ecosystem Services', 'Biodiversity Loss', and 'Climate Change' impacts. Frequently tested in Prelims via species interaction questions and in Mains via environmental ethics and sustainable development.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Interdependence.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
